name: Scan or import to fit result
userOutcome: A user can capture or select one full-body photo, receive honest on-device analysis, and reach a durable result without losing the photo on a recoverable failure.
productionDataSource: Live AVFoundation camera capture or a user-selected PhotosPicker item, analyzed by Vision, Core Image, deterministic local heuristics, and ScoreEngine.
errorBehavior: Camera denial offers Settings and library fallback. Import, analysis, and persistence failures show a retryable message. Cancellation is silent and distinct from failure. A staged original is removed when no session is created.
accessibilityRequirements: Camera and import actions have meaningful labels
Progress and cancellation remain reachable with VoiceOver
Permission recovery choices are announced distinctly
prohibitedBehavior: Do not activate deterministic Vision stubs in Release
Do not present heuristic style estimates as learned-model facts
Do not show or persist a score when the deterministic photo-quality gate rejects the input
Do not allow borderline photo quality to inherit an implausibly high outfit score
Do not spend a daily scan or persist a session after cancellation
acceptanceTests: ScoreEngineTests unusable-photo and borderline-photo ceiling tests
Physical-device camera, Photos picker, denial, interruption, and low-confidence matrix
